### The Mystery of the Faith
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/mystery-faith
Passage: 1 Timothy 3:9
Points:
- Although deacons focus primarily on mercy ministry rather than preaching, they regularly provide counsel and must be grounded in biblical truth.
- The mystery of the faith refers to the gospel message fully revealed through Christ and His apostles, including Christ's atoning sacrifice.
- Serving with a clear conscience means genuinely believing Christian doctrine in heart and mind, avoiding hypocrisy or empty lip service.
- Aspiring church leaders should prioritize growing in their knowledge of the faith and personal integrity over mere administrative skill.
